issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you live... on nothing... but your salary!
issues.justification: The punchline curse (the worst fate: living on a salary alone, as a corrupt/black-market person) is reduced to awkward, over-punctuated phrasing; the humor and the preceding curse structure ('Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках') are weakened, and the Yiddish-inflected speech is lost.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания... Значит, этот лопух ничего не знает.
issues.translation_quote: Comrade! AI-lyulyu would be lovely, but tsigel-tsigel! Time's running out! Those idiots swore he was unconscious...
issues.justification: 'Товарищ, товарищ... время, товарищ!' is the speaker's line pressed to the foreigners, and the translation garbles the nonsense phrases, introducing 'AI-lyulyu' with odd capitalization and an unnatural sentence that does not match the source.

Pseudo-foreign 'Облико морале' (moral character) is meant as the speaker's comic mixture; 'Morale impeccable' misrepresents it. Moreover 'Руссо туристо' is kept as 'Russo touristo!' but the point 'Soviet tourists behave morally' is blurred.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets, and you'll win... A water pump!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) that makes this a parody lottery slogan is lost.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I can't go along with that!
issues.justification: The deliberately uneducated, comic register ('пойтить') of the speaker is lost.

issues.source_quote: Вы говорите: поскользнулся, упал... закрытый перелом
issues.justification: Fine, but 'У тебя там не закрытый, а открытый перелом' keeps the pun; however 'открытый' as 'open fracture' misses that Nadya is hinting at the open secret/gold, which is acceptable. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Без сознания... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс
issues.translation_quote: Passed out, came to... A cast!
issues.justification: Fine overall; but 'Он согласился? - Согласился!' is okay. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники.
issues.translation_quote: even teetotalers drink when someone else is paying... and even ulcer sufferers!
issues.justification: The punchline structure is broken by the awkward ellipsis, weakening the Boss's aphorism.
